description: Right-hand fists shaken quickly back and forth, in two takes separated by a frame with no hands (0-15.5 s and 16-30.4 s). During fast movement MediaPipe loses the hand for a frame or two at a time, or the fingers swing past the edge, which puts the clutch on hold briefly. Before brief holds were bridged, the summed fist movement ended 0.3-0.5 frame widths away from where the knuckles actually moved. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every frame (~50 fps), so the one-frame dropouts are kept; labels are as the tracker sees them.
